screens.screen: CompressPage while compressing: LinearProgressIndicator, percentage, Cancel
CompressPage after compression: 'Pick and compress a video' + Size / Dimensions / Duration / output path

notes: Addendum 2 option 1: redrawn from the package's example app (repo ardev-dev/video_compressor_plus, branch stable, v4.1.0; it is a public fork continuing video_compress, as its README states). The example has exactly two pages; the three images are real distinct states: compressing, result, thumbnail page. English/LTR, Material 3 with colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo, system font. Sample data only: 47%, 3.9 MB, 568 x 320, 42367 ms and the output path (shape taken from the Swift code: NSTemporaryDirectory()/video_compress/<name><UUID>.mp4; UUIDs are made up). Fidelity doubts: (1) the M3 colours were computed by hand from the seed (tonal-spot: primary ~#505B92, surface ~#FBF8FF, secondaryContainer ~#DEE1F9) because material_color_utilities is not in the local pub cache - expect +-2 per channel; (2) the thumbnail picture is a drawn stand-in for the user's video frame (Image.memory of whatever video is picked), a 16:9 dusk landscape; (3) the progress bar uses Flutter's default 'year2023' flat style. The idle state (only the button, centred) was not drawn separately because the result state contains it.
